expectations.name: llm_judge(回复是一份结构化的代码评审：指出了给定代码的具体问题——例如, threshold=0.6)
expectations.message: The answer is a structured, severity-ordered code review that identifies concrete issues in service.py—such as silently swallowed payment exceptions, an overburdened method with many dependencies, poor return semantics, magic strings/log formatting, and missing tests—and provides actionable remediation steps.

writing.overall_comment: 内容专业、输出模板扎实,但边界模糊、工具权限与审查定位不符,且篇幅冗长重复,建议精简并明确只读权限与交接规则。

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: 描述清晰界定了架构/设计模式/代码质量审查的专长领域,主智能体可据此判断何时路由,但未点明具体触发场景(如 PR 审查、重构评审)。

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: 角色定位、审查重点、流程步骤与反馈模板(含代码审查总结结构)都写得非常明确,输出契约清晰可执行。

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: 虽列出沟通层面的「不应该做」清单,却缺少范围边界与交接条件,尤其授予了 Edit/Write 工具与「只审查不建议改代码」的定位存在潜在冲突。

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: 篇幅过长且高度重复(两处「最佳实践」、多处内容交叠),远超必要 token 预算,大量条目可合并精简。

suggestions: In the skill's tool permissions, remove Edit/Write or explicitly restrict them to non-mutating use to resolve the conflict with the 'review only, do not suggest code changes' positioning.
In the skill prompt, add explicit scope boundaries and handoff conditions so reviewers know what is in-scope, out-of-scope, and when to stop or escalate.
In the skill content, merge the two 'best practices' sections and overlapping items into one concise checklist to reduce token usage.
